baseline_pool.identity_policy: frozen-protocol-and-replicate; execution date is metadata only

install.policy: Run normal Claude Code from a fresh lane-specific runtime home/config with auth only; materialize the fixture project's AGENTS.md byte-for-byte as project CLAUDE.md so Claude's normal project-instruction discovery loads the same guidance available to the Codex/OpenCode workflows. Install no evaluator-authored MCP servers, plugins, skills, hooks, memory, retrieval, compression, or other tool-treatment surfaces. Keep HOME/PYTHONUSERBASE/XDG/TMPDIR isolated and record hashes plus preflight artifacts proving the instruction pair and normal native runtime surface.

reset.policy: Delete the lane-specific Claude runtime home, generated project CLAUDE.md, lane-local Git exclude entry, and run-local HOME/PYTHONUSERBASE/XDG/TMPDIR before each run; verify no stale indexes, generated profile files, hooks, skills, or memory survive.

evaluation_protocol.instruction_policy: Normal Claude Code invocation with project AGENTS.md materialized byte-for-byte as CLAUDE.md for native project-instruction discovery; no evaluator-installed tool treatment, MCP, plugins, skills, hooks, memory, retrieval, or compression surfaces

registry_entry.notes: Normal Claude Code control using the direct-Anthropic Claude Opus 5/medium forward condition. The workflow project's AGENTS.md is copied exactly to CLAUDE.md for native discovery; no evaluator-authored tool treatment is installed. Provider-free qualification is required before any provider-backed reproduction.

network_isolation.model_shell_enforcement: seccomp denies AF_INET and AF_INET6 socket creation for the shell process and descendants

runtime.isolation_policy: fresh lane-specific agent home/XDG state; provider-only network with model shell and agent web tools disabled; sequential one-task prompt delivery; controller seed/verifier scripts excluded while controller-only compile and essential-smoke commands retained; no acceptance-test assets injected; agent prompts carry normal software objectives

baseline_pool_reference.comparison_policy: paired baseline and treatment must share this baseline pool fingerprint and replicate

leakage_controls.model_writable_surface: target repository plus isolated model-output directory
remaining_limitations: Future semantic regression code is present from lane start. Agent prompts state normal software objectives and do not disclose controller scoring. Compile, essential-smoke, and controller verifier commands remain controller-only; no acceptance-test assets are injected.
Task semantics and verifier names may still be searchable if the model intentionally uses external network access.

artifacts.final_diff_basis: ordered cumulative checkpoints plus final cumulative source diff from one composite root
